data.one_liner: A drop-in replacement for the default text widget that automatically adds hyphenation.
data.what_it_does: AutoHyphenatingText acts as a drop-in replacement for the standard Flutter Text widget, automatically handling word hyphenation. It requires an initialization step to load the hyphenation algorithm before usage.
use_when: You need automatic hyphenation for text wrapping in Flutter layouts.
You want a drop-in replacement for the standard Text widget.
avoid_when: You cannot perform the asynchronous initialization required by the hyphenation algorithm.
You do not need hyphenation support.
strengths: Acts as a drop-in replacement for the default Text widget.
Supports customizable hyphenation characters and selectable text.
weaknesses: Requires an explicit asynchronous initialization step (`initHyphenation()`) before use.
data.setup_notes: Needs to be initialized using await initHyphenation(); before usage, unless manually initialized.
